question: What does the native endpoint show when a scheduled BETWEEN transfer is physically in transit or remains a transfer backorder?
controlled_delta: Each accepted 36-hour parent changes Control.SIMPE, Control.RCEND, every ResultCollection.RCEND, ProblemDescription, and OperationProfile only. The three scheduled h8/h20/h32 mission rows are replaced by one referenced h0 zero-initiation row to avoid out-of-horizon mission converter errors; this uses the accepted D02.var05 v1.0.2 zero-IQTY syntax. ItemTransfer, stock, seed, collection interval, and all other model cells stay fixed. The arms are separately parented endpoint probes, not a matched one-factor pair against each other.
pre_run_hypotheses: Both child inputs import, roundtrip exactly for 22 populated authored tables, convert with zero errors, and emit nonempty native output without changing the GUI. No mission initiation should occur.

Transit: the tracked unit leaves DEPOT-01 at h6; its scheduled h8 BASE-01 arrival lies outside the h7 simulation endpoint. The terminal inventory ledger must account for one in-transit physical unit without inventing a target stock arrival.
Backorder: the h2 request finds zero source stock; the h4 IN lies outside the h3 endpoint. The terminal ledger must retain an unsatisfied transfer request and must not invent a moved item.
If native endpoint truncation drops or transforms these states, publish the observed bounded behavior and classify any unsupported planned assertion explicitly.
acceptance_gate: Guarded session-0 SSH runs, exact roundtrips, zero converter errors, source-bound raw closures, direct item/task event and station inventory checks, terminal ledger reconciliation, author replay, separate read-only review, and staged source-hash audit.
limits: one IID, two stations, one seed and two endpoint times
profile deliberately suppresses missions, so this case makes no claim about transfer state under active aircraft demand
separate accepted parents; no generalized transfer priority or horizon law
GUI rendering and cross-engine parity unverified
